name: Gayatri Mantra
source_note: Traditional Gayatri Mantra; text reviewed against trusted printed references including Gita Press editions.
devanagari:
ॐ भूर् भुवः स्वः
तत् सवितुर् वरेण्यं
भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि
धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात्
transliteration:
Om Bhūr Bhuvaḥ Svaḥ
Tat Savitur Vareṇyaṃ
Bhargo Devasya Dhīmahi
Dhiyo Yo Naḥ Prachodayāt
meaning: We meditate on the supreme light of the Divine Sun, whose radiance pervades the earth, the atmosphere, and the heavens. May that light guide our intellect on the right path.
